text: 纳斯达克金龙中国指数收跌1.14%，报5765.90点，逼近6月25日收盘位5690.24点。 热门中概股里，小鹏初步收跌4.4%，理想跌3.3%，小米跌2.7%，百度、拼多多、比亚迪至少跌1.4%，日月光半导体跌0.3%，阿里涨0.1%，腾讯涨1.1%，网易涨1.3%。 ETF中，中概互联网指数ETF（KWEB）收跌1.01%，中国科技指数ETF（CQQQ）收跌0.11%。 德银嘉实沪深300指数ETF（ASHR）收跌0.63%，MSCI新兴市场ex中国ETF（EMXC）收跌0.21%，XtrackersHarvest中证50（ASHS）收涨0.13%
text_en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index closed down 1.14% at 5,765.90 points, approaching its June 25 close of 5,690.24 points. Among popular Chinese concept stocks, XPeng preliminarily closed down 4.4%, Li Auto fell 3.3%, Xiaomi fell 2.7%, Baidu, Pinduoduo and BYD fell at least 1.4%, ASE Semiconductor fell 0.3%, Alibaba rose 0.1%, Tencent rose 1.1%, and NetEase rose 1.3%. Among ETFs, the KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF (KWEB) closed down 1.01%, and the China Technology Index ETF (CQQQ) closed down 0.11%. The Deutsche X-trackers Harvest CSI 300 China A-Shares ETF (ASHR) closed down 0.63%, the MSCI Emerging Markets ex-China ETF (EMXC) closed down 0.21%, and the Xtrackers Harvest CSI 500 China A-Shares Small Cap ETF (ASHS) rose 0.13%.
